result.summary: Do not ship: saving settings silently resets General configuration and discards edits.

findings.title: Splitting the forms drops General fields and resets saved limits
findings.body: The General controls now belong to a separate form with no submit button. Clicking “Save Settings” submits only the instance form. In triggarr/web/routes.py:529–539, save_settings interprets the missing General fields as defaults and persists them: for example, an existing hard_max_per_cycle=10 becomes 0 (unlimited), skip_unreleased=True becomes False, and max_history_rows becomes 1000. Thus an ordinary instance save silently removes configured search restrictions, while edits to General fields cannot be saved with the button. The existing regression test at tests/test_web.py:832 explicitly covers this association.
findings.recommendation: Restore id="settings-form" on the instance form and form="settings-form" on every General control, keeping Security separate. Run test_general_fields_submit_with_the_save_settings_form and verify a save preserves nondefault General values.

next_steps: Restore the shared form association before merging.
